verdict.rationale: Ramp Treasury documents real yield mechanics (2% APY checking, up to 4.46% APY investment account backed by money-market funds/Treasuries) via ramp-docs-29 and ramp-supp-checking-account, but every account and disclosure described is USD-denominated, and the Banking API explicitly states 'Banking is US-only' (ramp-supp-banking-api). Stablecoin identifiers like USDC appear only in Bill Pay's monetary-value schema, not as a yield-bearing treasury balance. Missing for 10: any documented ability to hold or earn interest on non-USD currency balances, multi-currency treasury accounts, or FX-yield mechanics.
